findings.summary: GPU descriptors reuse the shared record-shape constructors.
Typed GPU destinations share one validation dispatch; owned resources call the native transport directly.
Compressed, layered and batched texture writes use the same shared GPU device boundary.
Single SDL buffer writes copy directly into mapped transfers; staging batches serve grouped writes.
Scene rendering reuses its planned scene snapshot, and filtered registry walks are linear.
ESM retirement marks active maps once in reusable scratch storage.
JSON parsing and dynamic property assignment share ordered insertion.
Frame drivers use coroutine keywords directly, without redundant macros.
Frame mutation fixtures register individual replacement scenes directly.
